mapper.insert: insert into health_record(user_id, metric_type, metric_value, unit, record_time, remark, created_at) values (#{userId}, #{metricType}, #{metricValue}, #{unit}, #{recordTime}, #{remark}, now())
mapper.update: update health_record set metric_type = #{metricType}, metric_value = #{metricValue}, unit = #{unit}, record_time = #{recordTime}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from health_record where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from health_record where user_id = #{userId}
select id, user_id, metric_type, metric_value, unit, record_time, remark, created_at from health_record where user_id = #{userId} order by record_time desc limit 1
select id, user_id, metric_type, metric_value, unit, record_time, remark, created_at from health_record where created_at >= #{startTime} order by created_at desc limit 500
